_meta.principle: Router knows model CAPABILITIES (resolution, duration, FLF support, ref-count). This file documents PROMPT-LEVEL behavior — what each model rewards and what it punishes.

rewards: explicit camera move + stability cue (locked / smooth / handheld)
single-axis direction per shot (no stacked verbs)
visible motivated light source — 'window from camera-left'
named lens + focal length when realism matters
explicit NO-X constraints when failure modes are known
punishes: stacked motion verbs ('pan AND dolly AND zoom')
abstract aesthetic descriptors without anchoring nouns
FLF mismatched physics (start frame and end frame depict impossible interpolation)
tips: Audio off saves 50% ($0.40/s → $0.20/s). Mix audio externally via tools/pipelines/audio/.
FLF: start AND end frames are mandatory for clean interpolation. Single-frame I2V drifts.

rewards: prompt focuses on motion/action — visual identity comes from refs
1-3 character/product/environment refs locked across all shots
named subject continuity ('Alex' is the same across shots)
punishes: describing visual details already in refs (wastes prompt budget)
more than 3 refs (hard cap)
FLF expectations (this is reference-mode, not frame-anchored)
tips: Use for multi-shot campaigns where character/product identity must lock.
Ref images burned 1h after upload — re-upload per session.

rewards: shorter clips (5s) drift less than long
explicit camera direction (up/down/left/right) — Kling reads 1-axis cleanly
FLF anchors stabilize identity
punishes: very long clips (>8s) — drift accumulates
complex motion compounds — keep it to ONE verb
abstract emotional descriptors with no visible referent
tips: Cheaper anchored A/B vs Veo at $0.112/s with FLF. Good for social-budget campaigns.
2026-05-03 hero-shot color regression flagged Kling as social-budget tier, not premium.

rewards: concise prompts — verbose hurts
explicit FLF anchors for identity continuity
resolution-aware pricing
punishes: long descriptive paragraphs
stacked motion verbs
tips: Resolution-tiered: 480p / 720p / 1080p, prices differ. Specify resolution context.
Best budget option for high-volume social where cost-per-second matters.

rewards: positive descriptive phrasing — 'locked camera', 'one visible hand'
concrete sensory verbs (steam rises, fabric sways, light shifts)
subject-motion + scene-motion described separately from camera-motion
image references carry 80% of visual identity — prompt is mostly motion
punishes: NO-X / negative constraints — Runway docs explicitly warn 'negative phrasing can behave unpredictably'
'don't', 'avoid', 'no' clauses — frequently produce the forbidden element instead
abstract emotional adjectives without visible motion referent
tips: Composer MUST rewrite NO-X constraints to positive equivalents for this family.
Examples: 'NO camera movement' → 'locked camera, no shake'; 'NO extra hands' → 'only one visible hand'; 'NO text on screen' → 'screen displays a clean photograph, no overlays'.

rewards: simple subject motion — head turn, hand wave, product rotate
clear single-axis camera direction
concrete short prompts
punishes: complex multi-element scenes
long abstract descriptions
stacked motion verbs
tips: Budget option for low-complexity social cuts. Drift escalates fast past 6s.
WaveSpeed listing — confirm pricing per invoice (no invoiceVerified flag yet).

rewards: talking-head lipsync — feed reference image + transcript
natural facial micro-motion under speech
sustained close-up shots
punishes: non-talking-head shots
complex camera moves
wide framing where face occupies <30% of frame
tips: Use exclusively for lipsync VO shots. Other shot types route to Veo/Kling/Seedance.
Pair with audio.json voice_over_styles + qa-rubrics.json#lipsync.

_constraint_rewrite_map._comment: Used by composePrompt per-model compilation when the model's negative_strategy is 'rewrite_to_positive'. Common NO-X patterns and their positive rewrites. Composer falls back to a generic 'with X visible only / cleanly framed' template if no map entry matches.
_constraint_rewrite_map.no extra fingers: five fingers per hand, anatomically correct
_constraint_rewrite_map.no text on screen: screen displays a clean photograph, no overlays
